purpose: Jointly open six receptor conformations and assign each of six chemical series to one receptor pair under the same docking budget, testing a deployment-relevant facility-location problem rather than another fixed-subset score.

frozen_problem.series_pair_minimum_coverage: minimum high-potency joint-hit coverage over three seeds
frozen_problem.series_pair_mean_coverage: mean high-potency joint-hit coverage over three seeds
frozen_problem.series_pair_low_exposure: mean global low-potency joint-hit exposure over three seeds
frozen_problem.series_pair_overlap: mean pair hit-set Jaccard over three seeds
frozen_problem.budget_interpretation: Each ligand series is docked to two receptors; this uses 12 series-receptor routes while permitting six distinct conformations. The all-series fixed-six baseline uses 36 routes, so the assignment policy targets a threefold routing reduction after receptor-opening costs are ignored.

exact_solver.formulation: mixed-integer linear program with receptor-open x_i, series-pair assignment a_gij, and worst-series variable t

classical_baselines.direct_greedy_open_set: start from the best receptor pair, add the receptor with the best exact conditional assignment value until six are open

stop_rule: If the gate fails, close BACE1 same-data objective engineering. If it passes, freeze this exact formulation before any new-target docking and test both hardness and screening quality prospectively.
